summary: Feature implemented but not verified by running tests (per instructions). Changes: rich/progress.py adds TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time (defaulted, after _get_time), finished derived from finished_time, capture rules in update/advance inside the lock, clearing in _reset and reset. rich/default_styles.py adds progress.elapsed (yellow). rich/palette.py adds Palette.__rich__ with local imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import. CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased/Added entry. tests/test_palette.py adds test_rich_cast. tests/test_progress.py adds test_time_elapsed_column (driven by public calls with a non-auto clock), imports TimeElapsedColumn, adds it to test_columns, and updates test_columns expected output by hand-tracing clock reads (bar widths 33->25 and 23->16, new 0:00:37/0:00:36 running cells, frozen 0:01:00/0:00:45 cells, bar speed 2->1 bytes/s, speed column padding dropped in finished frames). Glyph counts verified by grep. Nothing committed. Next step: run pytest tests/test_progress.py tests/test_palette.py to confirm the hand-derived test_columns expectation.
